faqs.question: What does Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Sputum measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects the presence of fungal DNA in sputum samples.

faqs.question: Why is Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Sputum done?
faqs.answer: This test detects the presence of fungal infections in the body by analysing the fungal DNA in sputum samples. Hence, this test is prescribed • To diagnose fungal infections in the respiratory tract. • To identify specific types of fungi causing the infection. • To monitor the effectiveness of antifungal treatment. • To guide clinicians in selecting appropriate antifungal medications. • To differentiate between fungal and bacterial respiratory infections.

faqs.question: When is Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Sputum recommended, and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended when you exhibit symptoms such as persistent cough, shortness of breath, chest pain, or fever, which may indicate a respiratory fungal infection. Patients with compromised immune systems, pre-existing lung conditions, or exposure to certain environments may also be advised to take this test.

faqs.question: What if the results of Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Sputum are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate the presence of a fungal infection in the respiratory tract. However, further evaluation is necessary to determine the specific type of fungus causing the infection.

faqs.question: What to expect during Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Sputum?
faqs.answer: You will be required to provide a sputum sample in a sterile container. The sample will then be sent to the laboratory for analysis.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Sputum?
faqs.answer: Collect a sputum sample as per the sampling guidelines provided by your healthcare provider. Ensure that the specimen type, site, and relevant clinical history are properly mentioned on the Test Request Form (TRF). Follow any instructions given by your doctor regarding medications or dietary restrictions before the test. Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Sputum?
faqs.answer: • Fungal culture: A test that helps grow and identify specific types of fungi from samples. • Antifungal susceptibility testing: Determines which antifungal medications are effective against the identified fungal strain. • Chest X-ray or CT scan: Imaging tests to evaluate the extent of lung involvement and identify any complications associated with fungal infections.

faqs.question: What is Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – Sputum also known as?
faqs.answer: Fungal DNA PCR test, sputum fungal DNA analysis

faqs.question: What is a fungal respiratory infection?
faqs.answer: A fungal respiratory infection is an infection caused by various types of fungi that affect the respiratory system, including the lungs and airways. Symptoms may include coughing, fever, chest pain, and difficulty breathing. Early identification is important for prompt treatment.
